title: Genshin Rotation
subtitle: Serial snapping of on-field stints & Skill/Burst cooldown and buff overlap simulator

slot.label: Team:
slot.noneTitle: No saved rotations (save one with "Save as")

overwrite.title: Overwrite "{{name}}" with the current state
overwrite.disabledTitle: Load a saved rotation from the Team list to overwrite it

saveAs.title: Save the current state to a new slot

playback.resetToOpener: Back to the start of the opener (-{{seconds}}s)
playback.cycleTitle: Playback cycle: currently cycle {{count}} (kept while paused or when seeking inside the loop; seeking into the opener or resetting returns to cycle 1)
playback.loopPeriodFromStart: Length of one loop (from the loop start to the end)

ct.collisionTitle_one: [⚠️ Cooldown conflict] {{count}} action is used before its cooldown has recovered (marked in red on the Gantt chart)
ct.collisionTitle_other: [⚠️ Cooldown conflicts] {{count}} actions are used before their cooldowns have recovered (marked in red on the Gantt chart)
ct.okTitle: [✅ All clear] Every action in the rotation is used after its cooldown has recovered
ct.warningTitle: [Cooldown warnings] {{count}} in total: triggered buffs (passive talents, weapons, artifacts) placed during their cooldown, special skills placed outside their window, and plunging attacks that do not meet gcsim's requirements (triggered buffs simply do not activate, special skills are treated as normal skills, and plunging attacks cause a gcsim error)

collapse.expandTitle: Show the database and tools menu (▼)
collapse.collapseTitle: Hide the database and tools menu (△)

menu.helpTitle: How to use (basic flow, reading the screen, controls, gcsim, saving, notation)
menu.partyTitle: Set the 4 party members, weapons and artifacts
menu.databaseTitle: Sync the latest official data for characters, weapons and artifacts, and edit custom entries
menu.gcsimComputeTitle: Run gcsim: runs the current team and rotation in gcsim and applies action times, cooldowns, durations and triggered buffs at once (runs even if the app finds cooldown conflicts; nothing is applied if gcsim has to wait. Undo with "Back to app calculation")
menu.copyGcsimConfigTitle: Convert the current team and rotation to a gcsim config and copy it to the clipboard (warnings are shown too)
menu.resetToAppTitle: Keep the action order, but remove gcsim results and individually changed action times, cooldowns and durations, and go back to the app's calculation (master frames and cooldowns)
menu.copyNotationTitle: Copy the text notation (e.g. Xingqiu(Q E) ➔ [Bennett(Q E) ➔ Xiangling(Q E)]; [ ] is the part repeated from the 2nd cycle on)
